decision.evidence: Thorsten explicitly confirmed the refined package A for time, freshness, and confidence in the current task.

time.observedAt: UTC RFC3339 timestamp from the observing execution node
time.freshnessAsOf: UTC RFC3339 timestamp from the evaluating AOC process
time.futureTimestampRule: A future observedAt beyond maxClockSkewSeconds yields Unknown freshness and blocks Known state
time.toleratedSkewRule: A future observedAt within maxClockSkewSeconds is clamped to age zero, emits CLOCK_SKEW_TOLERATED, and caps confidence at Medium

unknownConditions: Future observedAt beyond the profile clock-skew allowance

rules.when: Fresh, valid source, valid authority, no conflict, and no tolerated clock skew
Aging with valid source and authority and no conflict, or Fresh with tolerated clock skew
Stale but still usable, or Degraded with explicitly usable partial or conflicting evidence
Freshness is Expired or Unknown, or source, authority, time, or usable evidence is missing

stateDerivationOrder: Invalid or missing time, source, authority, or value-or-absence evidence yields Unknown
Explicitly unavailable source or Expired freshness yields Unavailable
Authority or source conflict with usable evidence yields Degraded
Fresh or Aging freshness with valid source and authority and no conflict yields Known

envelope.sourceConflictPolicy: Preserve every contributing source and conflict; never use silent last-writer-wins
envelope.projectionPolicy: JSON and text expose the same field values and ordering semantics; later presentation may change layout but not meaning

crossCutting.security: Reason details must not expose secrets, credentials, or unneeded host internals; missing or conflicting authority fails closed
crossCutting.privacy: The envelope contains no unnecessary personal data and minimises host, repository, and user identifiers
crossCutting.accessibility: Text status is German-first and English-second, compatible with WCAG 2.2 AA, screen readers, and colour-independent meaning
crossCutting.platformRule: Identical inputs and policy profiles yield identical status, freshness, confidence, and reason codes on every supported platform
crossCutting.supplyChain: N/A for the requirements-only contract and fixtures; introducing implementation dependencies requires SBOM and vulnerability evidence
